# Natural Grid LLP

> Natural Grid LLP is a service-first solar energy company headquartered in Sulthan Bathery, Wayanad, Kerala, providing engineering, installation, and lifecycle maintenance for rooftop solar systems across all 14 districts in Kerala.

## Company Information
- Name: Natural Grid LLP
- Headquarters: Sulthan Bathery, Wayanad, Kerala, India - 673592
- Phone: +91 90726 34443
- Email: info@naturalgrid.in
- Website: https://naturalgrid.in
- Working Hours: Monday - Saturday: 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM IST (24h response target)

## Core Services
- Rooftop Solar Installation: On-grid, off-grid, and hybrid solar photovoltaic (PV) power systems for residential homes, villas, commercial establishments, and institutions.
- Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC): Preventive solar panel cleaning, electrical testing, inverter diagnostics, string monitoring, thermal imaging, and guaranteed breakdown response across Kerala.
- Battery Backup & Hybrid Storage: LiFePO4 and lead-acid solar battery energy storage systems (BESS) for uninterrupted power supply during grid outages.
- PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana: End-to-end subsidy documentation, KSEB Soura net-metering portal application, technical feasibility review, and commissioning assistance for central government subsidies up to ₹78,000.
- Solar Water Heating: ETC and FPC pressurized and non-pressurized solar thermal water heaters.
